_comment: Config for `cargo run --release --example tree -- run/examples/tree.json`. Every key is optional (defaults = obrrt's); keys starting with _ are ignored. This file is the current best setup (v46-mw).

run._boot: "default" (menu-skip inputs), "tas" (2026 TAS to first control, 44 frames sooner), or a path to a headerless m64 prefix

env._comment: objective-side switches read from the environment (see objectives/OBJECTIVES.md)

kind_weights._comment: per-kind objective weight multipliers (1 = unchanged); kinds are listed in objectives/OBJECTIVES.md. Examples:
